items.title: Cardinal Health (NYSE:CAH) Misses Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
items.summary: Healthcare distributor and services company Cardinal Health (NYSE:CAH) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 5.8% year on year to $63.67 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.91 per share was 20.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
